founder.title: Hello, I'm Adel, CEO & Teacher at Rekaz
founder.bio: I want you to know that our mission is bigger than teaching subjects — it's about helping you believe in yourself, discover your potential, and achieve your dreams. Every lesson we give is designed with your future in mind, because I believe each of you has the ability to succeed and make a difference. Rekaz is more than a school; it's a place where together we build the confidence, knowledge, and ambition that will carry you forward in life.

aboutPreview.text: At Rekaz, we believe education is more than lessons — it is the foundation for building confident, ambitious, and successful lives. From the early years of CEM to the challenges of BEM and BAC, our mission is to guide every student with care, innovation, and passion. Rekaz is not just a school, but a home where dreams are nurtured, values are strengthened, and futures are shaped.

faq.title: Questions about Rekaz? We're here to help.

items.q: Which school levels does Rekaz support?
items.a: We support all CEM (Middle School) levels from 1CEM to 4CEM/BEM, and all Lycée (High School) levels from 1AS to 3AS/BAC.
Yes, we provide comprehensive support across all subjects required for both middle school and high school curriculums.

items.q: What is included in BEM and BAC preparation?
items.a: Our preparation includes intensive subject review, past paper practice, mock exams, and strategic guidance to build confidence.
We offer practical courses in entrepreneurship, marketing, digital skills, cybersecurity, and advanced management.
Yes, all our professional formations conclude with a valid certificate upon successful completion.
Our modern E-Learning platform is launching soon, allowing you to learn anything, anywhere, anytime.
